overview: This Senate resolution designates September 21 through 27, 2025, as Gold Star Families Remembrance Week. A gold star symbolizes a family member who died in the line of duty while serving in the military, and the resolution notes that, apart from Gold Star Mother's Day on the last Sunday of September, there is no date dedicated to these families. It honors the sacrifices of families of service members who died defending the country and of families of veterans, and encourages Americans to mark the week with acts of service and good will in their communities. The Senate adopted it by unanimous consent on September 19, 2025.
for: Supporters say the week gives the country a chance to recognize and support families who lost loved ones in military service.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or provide new benefits for Gold Star families.
